name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-11-03, at wavelengths from 1.61 to 4.95 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
